characterList.description: Male, wearing glasses and a black hoodie with the word 'ODYSSEY' printed in pink and blue. He has his dark hair tied in a bun.

content_metadata.description: Ash guides viewers in replicating Skrillex's vocal chop sound using stock plugins and Serum. He provides a step-by-step walk-through of his process, including acapella selection, vocal chop assembly, and final sound design techniques.
